content: In all the hubub about BonBon yesterday, I forgot to mention that we have a demo site that lets you view Markdown sites in a historic browser like Firefox, Brave or Chrome. Since that is still what most of us use most of the time, at least for now, it's good to have that option. For example, this is what my blog looks like in BonBon. The archive goes back to 2017, and we're going to go much further back when I get the time to work with Claude on this project. Also, the "Book" stylesheet makes it look great. You can change the stylesheet by clicking on the big A in the icon area at the top of the page.
